text: Bitcoin is holding steady while Ethereum is edging lower, suggesting investors are cautious about the broader market direction rather than confident in either major asset. Fear sentiment at 27 remains elevated despite a slight weekly uptick, and Bitcoin's dominant 56.3% market share indicates money is rotating toward perceived safety rather than risk-on altcoins. Total 24-hour volume of $39B is moderate, reflecting the lack of conviction to push prices decisively in either direction.
